title: JazzWorld and UNICEF Partner for Digital Inclusion and AI
excerpt: JazzWorld has signed a Letter of Intent with UNICEF to work on initiatives advancing digital inclusion and inclusive AI foundations.
body_html:
JazzWorld has entered into an agreement with UNICEF through a signed Letter of Intent. The collaboration aims to explore various initiatives focused on advancing digital inclusion.

Additionally, the partnership seeks to build foundations for inclusive artificial intelligence. As a digital services platform in the region, JazzWorld's involvement centers on these cooperative goals with UNICEF.
